name: speedboat hero asset contract
about: ONE contract read by the Blender build (scripts/blender/*.py), the GLB checker (scripts/blender/checkGlb.mjs) and the runtime loader (src/speedboat/assets/). docs/speedboat/asset-pipeline.md explains each rule.

frame.origin: CG = the body frame of src/speedboat/hullMesh.ts (hull frame minus CG)
frame.blender: Blender (x, y, z) = three (x, -z, y): the bow points to Blender -Y, up is Blender +Z; the glTF exporter's +Y-up conversion does the rest

M_Gelcoat.surface: hull topsides + transom gelcoat, clearcoat, livery mask in baseColor alpha

M_Antifoul.surface: running bottom up to the chine

drawBudgetNote: primitives (draw calls, excluding shadow passes) per LOD for ONE boat: static parts merge into one node per slot; only animated nodes (outboards, props, wheel, dial, throttle levers) stay separate at LOD0, and they fold into merged nodes at LOD1/2 (browser sync 2026-09-13: 72 draws per boat before)
